run.exit_status_note: This manifest aggregates separately recorded process receipts, not one shell-command exit. The initial run was partial after an early resource-driven SIGTERM; the continuation completed all selected sources but diagnosed terminal errors and was finalized after a terminal-only diagnostic SIGTERM. The first repaired-terminal run was killed with a contemporaneous cgroup OOM event. The unchanged-source synchronous retry suffered a second recorded OOM kill. The factored terminal replay and three audits exited successfully; both axiom negative controls deliberately exited 1.
